statements.statement: The member has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The member has a known history of cerebral infarction
The member has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The diagnosis codes submitted are G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary to identify a paroxysmal arrhythmia
